tables.name: Political Rumors
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. Political happenings discussed in the village; the more remote the village, the larger the grain of salt.

results.name: Mighty Misfortune
results.description: Misfortune has fallen upon a prominent figure residing near to, but outside the bounds of, the settlement (stripped of title, robbed, murdered, lost at cards, etc).

results.name: Fealty
results.description: A new power is claiming rights of fealty over the village, at the culmination of a long conflict.

results.name: Drums of War
results.description: Neighboring cities are preparing to go to war with one another.

results.name: Noble Wedding
results.description: A local noble has just married the son or daughter of a well-loved (or greatly-loathed) family.

results.name: More Taxes
results.description: An increase in taxes is about to be implemented, to pay for an expensive and ambitious project.

results.name: Missing Taxman
results.description: Taxes have not been collected in quite some time, and no one has seen the collector for weeks.
